actions.body: Revisiting foundational assumptions in automated reasoning necessitates acknowledging the inherent limitations of data-driven black-box models. Evidence suggests that big data optimism frequently fails to account for structural phase transitions and the opaqueness of algorithmic decision-making. By applying network analysis, we can better identify the transitions where these assumptions degrade, shifting the focus from perfect transparency to robust error handling.
actions.lede: Optimism regarding big data often obscures the structural risks of black-box algorithms.
